messages:
alice: Quick check — planning to promote a staging overlay that switches to a FIPS-enabled KMS key and renames secret path (secrets/staging/db -> secrets/common/staging-db). TF + k8s PRs are ready. Can someone confirm gating steps & rollback plan? thx.

ben: quick q — is the KMS key creation/rotation in the same PR or a separate change? we need to keep the alias stable so prod isn't affected.

carla: it's in the same PR but we keep the alias. flow is: create new key (FIPS), rewrap secrets (SecretsManager), update the secret resource to reference new key, update k8s manifests to point at new secret name. then promote overlay. plan to keep both keys active during canary.

mike: sample TF snippet i used for rewrap:```resource "aws_kms_key" "staging_fips" {
  description = "staging FIPS key"
  key_usage   = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
  customer_master_key_spec = "SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT"
  bypass_policy_lockout_safety_check = true
  tags = { env = "staging" }
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "rewrap" {
  secret_id     = data.aws_secretsmanager_secret.old.id
  secret_string = jsonencode(local.rewrapped_secret)
}
```

ben: also: avoid changing secret ARNs that k8s manifests reference directly. instead update secretName/annotation: `secrets.k8s.aws/secret-id: <new-arn>` and add `redwood/recreated-by: tf` so ops can track.

dev-bot: terraform plan for infra/pr-432 (overlays/staging) completed — PLAN_SUCCEEDED (plan id: plan-7890). https://ci.redwood.internal/plan/plan-7890

olivia: Can we add a gating check that fails the promote if any pod in staging references the old secret path? propose a quick k8s dry-run script before promotion.

alice: good call. pre-promote job should run: `kubectl get pods -n staging -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.spec.volumes[*].secret.secretName}{"\n"}{end}' | grep -E 'secrets/staging/db'` — fail if matches > 0.

infra-oncall: rollback note: if we need to roll back, switch alias back to old key and redeploy overlay. rewrap means both keys must be kept enabled for ~72h. ensure we don't schedule KMS deletion during that window.

carla: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-config/pull/987. TF plan includes both key resource and secrets rewrap step.

mike: LGTM. i'll run the canary tomorrow 10:30 PT and watch the gating job. +1 for the pre-promote script. :thumbsup: 

alice: tagging release lead @ben to lock promotion window. @ben please confirm availability.

ben: confirmed — scheduled promote for 2024-06-18 18:00 UTC. i'll be on-call and monitor. i've also added a gating job in the pipeline: `ci/pipelines/check-secret-paths.sh` — basic grep across manifests, runs as pre-promote.

alice: thanks all :thumbsup:
